summary: Backend 19/19 passed (products CRUD, stock +/- with negative guard, sales with atomic stock decrement, Object Storage upload/download, push register 500 expected in preview, non-blocking push on status/chat, photo URL persistence). Frontend: Hdtech branding, Loja menu, product create/edit/search with margin preview, stock stepper + low-stock alert + invested summary, sale cart with stepper capped at stock + payment methods + confirm (stock 4->2, revenue updated R$1579,80->R$1859,80), OS regression (3-step create, status advance, chat) all passed. minor.issue: Only accepts tracking_code, not order UUID. Frontend client portal navigates to /order/{uuid}?role=client which calls getTracking(uuid) -> 404. Consider accepting both: find_one({'$or': [{'tracking_code': code}, {'id': code}]})

ui_bugs.issue: Client portal 'Ver detalhes e conversar' pushes params {id: order.id, role: 'client'} but order/[id].tsx with role=client calls api.getTracking(String(id)) which queries by tracking_code, so the UUID 404s and the client sees 'OS nao encontrada / Codigo de acompanhamento invalido'. NOTE: loadMessages also uses the route id param (api.listMessages(String(id))), so the fix must either make the tracking endpoint accept UUIDs (preferred, backend one-liner) or switch message loading to order.id after load.

integration_issues.issue: Client cannot open order detail or chat from the portal; tracking lookup itself works (status/code shown, profit/parts hidden correctly).

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix client detail navigation. client.tsx passes order.id (UUID) as route param while role=client path in order/[id].tsx calls api.getTracking(id) (tracking_code lookup) -> 404. Easiest fix: backend GET /api/tracking/{code} should also match order id (e.g. {'$or': [{'tracking_code': code.upper()}, {'id': code}]}).
MINOR: order/[id].tsx Resumo shows share link '/acompanhar/{tracking_code}' but no /acompanhar route exists in app/ — link is dead on web preview. Either add the route or change displayed path.

rca_of_issue: Bug: client portal detail navigation fails. Reproduce: /client -> enter TF-066E2A -> Consultar ordem -> 'Ver detalhes e conversar' -> red error 'Codigo de acompanhamento invalido'. RCA: client.tsx router.push({pathname: '/order/[id]', params: {id: order.id, role: 'client'}}); order/[id].tsx load() calls api.getTracking(String(id)) when isClient, hitting GET /api/tracking/{uuid} which only matches tracking_code -> 404 (verified: tracking by UUID returns 404). Mitigation: make tracking endpoint also match order id, or pass tracking_code and switch loadMessages/send to use order.id after load. Workaround until fixed: none for clients on web.
